name: Carnevale
description: A masked ball where everyone looks alike. Blend in, find your quarry, unmask them. Inspired by SpyParty.

controls.action: Walk there, or mark a figure
Back into step (or tap your shadow)
Unmask the figure in front of you

badges.name: Faux Pas
badges.description: Unmask a reveller who was only a reveller.

badges.name: Ghost
badges.description: Finish a round of Masquerade without being unmasked.

badges.name: Hush Hero
badges.description: Unmask someone in the Hush, after midnight strikes.

badges.name: Close Call
badges.description: Your pursuer blunders right beside you.

badges.name: Master of Disguise
badges.description: Hunt for a whole minute without getting flustered.

badges.name: Sharp Eye
badges.description: Five unmasks in one match without a single faux pas.

badges.name: Case Closed
badges.description: Solve Spot the Mask against Master impostors.

badges.name: Full House
badges.description: Play a round with ten players.
